services.name: All Charters
services.desc: One of the most popular bottom fish species to target in the Puget Sound is lingcod. Contrary to its name, the lingcod is actually not a cod; these eel shaped fish are part of the greenling family of fish species. The meat of a lingcod is white and flaky much like a cod, halibut, or any of your traditional white meat fish seen around the West coast, but lingcod generally proves to be superior table fare with its moist texture. This moist, flaky lingcod meat doesn’t dry out as easily as a halibut or cod meat, which makes it an even more desirable fish.
